svg.text: Database diagram: no database server; the data lives in files and on the phone
PK identifies a row, FK points at another store, UQ is unique. Crow's feet give cardinality: a ring is zero, a bar is one, a fork is many.
skillgap/ · one document, written by validate.py
backend/.cache/ · rebuilt when the key changes
The server stores nothing about students.
The phone's ids are references by value:
the API checks them on every request (422),
and the app drops ids it no longer serves.
